text:
rachel: spotted a new class of funcall parse failures on the zephyr-int4 canary. payloads often parse cleanly then the parser errors on a short trailing suffix that decodes as little-endian UTF16 or occasional control bytes. ~2.8% structured calls.

omar: can you paste a raw capture?

rachel: raw stream sample:```
{"tool":"kb_lookup","q":"serving runtime docs"}
\x66\x00\x6f\x00\x00\x00
```

leo: that looks like UTF16-LE chars after the JSON object (0x0066 0x006f => "fo"). different from random garbage. any correlates with kvcache or batch splitting?

rachel: yes strong signal: >80% of failures when kvcache_rotate=true and batch_size>=10. single-request flows clean.

ana: (sorry quick note) we should avoid stripping arbitrary bytes without classifying: if it's utf16 tail we can convert/strip safely, but we must record counts.

leo: triage ideas:
- short-term: add a utf16-tail detector that tries to decode trailing bytes as utf16-le/utf16-be sequences and, if valid and results look asciiish, convert/strip before json parse (emit metric utf16_tail_detected)
- alternative short-term: sentinel/anchor per-request `<<END:crc32:rand12>>` to validate complete funcall payloads; sentinel reduces ambiguity but requires injection in postprompt only
- short+fallback: sanitizer that strips non-utf8 trailing bytes then tries NDJSON-last-object parse + 1 retry

omar: we should run a 3-arm canary experiment (flags only): A) baseline B) utf16-strip + 1 retry C) sentinel-suffix with per-request 12-byte salt. collect schema_compliance, utf16_tail_detected_pct, sanitizer_trim_pct, sentinel_collision_count, parse_retry_success, p95/p99 latency. 2k structured calls per arm.

rachel: also add parse_error_class metric with values: utf16_tail | invalid_utf8 | trailing_bytes | incomplete_json. helps prioritize root cause.

leo: infra follow-ups: instrument kvcache rotation events with rotation_id and record post-decode raw bytes (PII-free) for failed parses into secure bucket. file INF-10321. we'll need to redact prompt content.

ana: safety: utf16-strip should only remove a trailing suffix if it decodes to reasonable unicode (printable chars or whitespace) and round-trips to ascii/utf8; record utf16_strip_bytes histogram. avoid dropping binary attachments.

rachel: proto harness: I created a tiny repro that simulates kvcache rotation mid-batch and reproduces the utf16 tails locally; linking INF-10321. will attach minimal dataset of failing hex dumps.

ci-bot: canary status: zephyr-int4 at 5% traffic. rolling schema_fail_rate (30m): 2.9%.

omar: implementation notes: keep behaviors behind runtime flags `postproc.utf16_strip`, `postproc.sentinel_suffix`, `postproc.sanitize_trail`. add metric tags model=zephyr-int4 quant=int4 batch_size kvcache_rotate arm.

leo: if sentinel arm shows near-zero collisions and low latency impact, its an easy short-term win. still file runtime bug to fix underlying memcpy/encode path that may be writing 16-bit checksums or rotating buffers with wrong stride. assign runtime team INF-10322.

ana: experiments: I'll run 2k/arm tonight and post a short notebook with schema pass rates, sanitizer mutations, utf16 detections, sentinel collisions, and latency histograms. ETA tomorrow AM.

rachel: thanks  I'll disable kvcache rotation for a tiny subset to confirm causality after the first experiment. tagging leo/omar.

ci-bot: note: please ensure all raw dumps in INF-10321 are stored in secure bucket with access control.
